An '''environment capsule''' was a type of [[Drop pod/Legends|drop pod]] used for high [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] precision entry.<ref name="CSWE HOPE" /> The four members of the [[High Orbit Precision Entry Squad]] used environment capsules during their [[Mission to Yorn Skot|mission]] to [[Yorn Skot]].<ref name="CSWE HOPE" />
